title: Restore full post-compact context attachments
objective: Expand Go post-compact recovery from files-only to the full TS set of context-restoring attachments supported by the Go product surface.
implementation_scope: Keep and harden existing recent file recovery, including dedup against preserved tail reads and allowed directory restrictions.
Add plan file recovery if Go has plan state.
Add plan-mode reminder recovery if Go has plan mode.
Add invoked skills attachment recovery scoped by agent/session.
Add async/background agent status attachments if Go has background agents.
Add deferred tools, agent listing, and MCP instruction delta attachments where Go has equivalent registries.
Represent every recovered item as an attachment/hook result in CompactionResult instead of appending ad hoc user messages.
out_of_scope: Do not invent product surfaces that Go does not have; mark unsupported attachment types in code comments/tests.
Do not re-inject full skill listings if the TS behavior intentionally avoids it.
acceptance_criteria: Post-compact message order remains boundary, summary, kept messages, attachments, hook results.
Recent files are not restored when already visible in preserved tail.
Supported plan/skill/MCP/agent state survives a compact in tests or fixture-based integration tests.
Unsupported TS attachment types are explicitly documented rather than silently ignored.
risks: Some attachment systems may live outside compact package; keep interfaces narrow to avoid cycles.
Attachments can bloat post-compact context and must respect token budgets.
dispatch_prompt: Expand Go post-compact recovery to restore files, plans, skills, async agents, deferred tools, agent listings, and MCP instructions where supported.
